data.name: The Sunset Land
data.detailed_description:
Your journey, your rules

Trailblaze like no one else. Create your ideal character and venture forth. Choose exactly how to behave as you complete quests and grow stronger.

To change the world

Adaptive players who find creative solutions to the problems they face are rewarded with the power to change fate itself: Destinata points, which can be spent in combat to cheat an otherwise certain death.

Focused and replayable

The Sunset Land has a short runtime and several alternate quest solutions, designed with casual replay in mind. Experience the fun of a cowboy power fantasy without the commitment of a long RPG.

Main features

  • Highly interactive maps full of people to talk to, containers to loot, and places to forage

  • Entirely unique interactions for low Intellect and low Humanity characters

  • An accessible auto-battle system for maximum ease of use

Special features

  • An original score by Benedikt Moeller

  • An in-game journal that you can write yourself, useful for taking notes and roleplaying

  • An in-game manual, easily accessible during regular gameplay for your convenience

data.short_description: The Sunset Land is a survival CRPG. Journey across the burgeoning American frontier and become a legendary cowboy.

content_descriptors.notes: Features frequent violence. One ending depicts the silhouette of the player character hanging after being sentenced to death. Contains moderate use of archaic profanity. Sex and alcohol are occasionally mentioned. Additionally, use of this software is strongly discouraged for players with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.
